visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Object.create Instead of new Parent()
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The child's prototype is made by calling new Animal(...), which runs the parent constructor with a dummy argument, and Dog sets name itself. Link the prototypes with Object.create and call the parent constructor from Dog. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: new Animal("unused") creates a throw-away parent object only to serve as a prototype, and it breaks if the parent constructor needs real arguments. Object.create links the prototypes without running any constructor.
